items.text: Wabhalwa kanjalo wonke u-Israyeli ngezizukulwane; bheka, zilotshiwe encwadini yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli nakwaJuda, awathunjelwa eBabele ngenxa yeziphambeko zawo.
Abakhileyo kuqala emafeni abo emizini yabo kwakungu-Israyeli, nabapristi, namaLevi, namaNethini.
EJerusalema kwahlala abanye babantwana bakwaJuda nabanye babantwana bakwaBenjamini nabanye babantwana bakwa-Efrayimi noManase;
u-Uthayi indodana ka-Amihudi indodana ka-Omri indodana ka-Imri indodana kaBani emadodaneni kaPheresi indodana kaJuda.
NakwabaseSiloni; u-Asaya izibulo namadodana akhe.
Emadodaneni kaSeraki; uJehuweli nabafowabo, bengamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi ayisishiyagalolunye;
kubantwana bakwaBenjamini; uSalu indodana kaMeshulamu indodana kaHodawiya indodana kaHasenuwagi,
no-Ibineja, indodana kaJerohamu, no-Ela, indodana ka-Uzi, indodana kaMigri, noMeshulamu indodana kaShefathiya, indodana kaRehuweli, indodana ka-Ibiniya;
nabafowabo ngezizukulwane zabo, amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi ayisihlanu nesithupha. Wonke la madoda ayeyizinhloko zezindlu zoyise ezindlini zawoyise.
Nakubapristi; uJedaya noJehoyaribi noJagini,
no-Azariya indodana kaHilikiya indodana kaMeshulamu indodana kaSadoki indodana kaMerayoti indodana ka-Ahithubi, umbusi wendlu kaNkulunkulu;
no-Adaya, indodana kaJerohamu, indodana kaPhashuri, indodana kaMalikiya, noMahasayi, indodana ka-Adiyeli, indodana kaJagishera, indodana kaMeshulamu, indodana kaMesilemiti, indodana ka-Imeri;
nabafowabo, izinhloko zezindlu zoyise, inkulungwane namakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi ayisithupha; amadoda amaningi anamandla emsebenzini wenkonzo yendlu kaNkulunkulu.
NakubaLevi; emadodaneni kaMerari, uShemaya, indodana kaHasubu, indodana ka-Asrikamu, indodana kaHashabiya;
noBakibakari, noHeresi, noGalali, noMathaniya, indodana kaMika, indodana kaSigri, indodana ka-Asafa;
no-Obadiya indodana kaShemaya indodana kaGalali indodana kaJeduthuni noBeregiya indodana ka-Asa indodana ka-Elkana owayehlala emizini yamaNethofa.
Abalindisango babengoShalumi, no-Akubi, noThalimoni, no-Ahimani, nabafowabo; uShalumi wayeyinhloko;
obesehlale esangweni lenkosi ngasempumalanga kuze kube manje; babengabalindisango ngezigaba zabantwana bakwaLevi.

UShalumi, indodana kaKora, indodana ka-Ebiyasafa, indodana kaKhora, nabafowabo bendlu kayise, amaKhora, babephethe umsebenzi wenkonzo, nabalindi bamasango etabernakele, kanye nawoyise, phezu kwebutho leNkosi kwakukhona abalindi bomnyango.
UFinehasi indodana ka-Eleyazare wayengumbusi phezu kwabo ngaphambili, uJehova wayenaye.
UZakariya indodana kaMeshelemiya wayengumlindisango womnyango wetende lokuhlangana.

Bonke laba ababekhethwe ukuba babe ngabalindisango basemasangweni babengamakhulu amabili neshumi nambili. Babhalwa ngezizukulwane zabo emadolobheni abo, uDavide noSamuweli umboni ababewabeka esikhundleni sabo kuze kube phakade.
Bona nabantwana babo balinda amasango endlu kaJehova, indlu yetabernakele njengabalindi.
Abalindisango babenezinhlangothi ezine, ngasempumalanga, nangasentshonalanga, nasenyakatho, naseningizimu.
Abafowabo ababesemizini yabo kwakumelwe bahambe nabo izikhathi ngezikhathi emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngokuba lawa maLevi, abalindisango abane abakhulu, babesezikhundleni zabo, bephethe amakamelo nengcebo yendlu kaNkulunkulu.
Bachitha ubusuku bezungeza indlu kaNkulunkulu, ngokuba umyalo wawuphezu kwabo, ukuvulwa kwayo kwakuphezu kwabo njalo ekuseni.
Abanye kubo babephethe izitsha zenkonzo ukuba bazingenise bazikhiphe njengomthetho.
Abanye kubo babemiswe ukuba baqondise izitsha nazo zonke izinto zendlu engcwele nofulawa ocolekileyo newayini namafutha nempepho namakha.
Abanye bamadodana abapristi benza amakha amakha.
UMatitha, omunye wamaLevi, izibulo likaShalumi umKorahi, wayenesikhundla esimisiwe phezu kwezinto ezenziwe ngamapani.
Abanye kubafowabo emadodaneni amaKohati babephethe izinkwa zokubukwa ukuze bazilungise isabatha ngamasabatha.
Laba babengabahlabeleli, izinhloko zezindlu zoyise zamaLevi, ababehlala emakamelweni, bekhululekile, ngokuba babesebenza kulowo msebenzi imini nobusuku.
Lezi izinhloko zemindeni yamaLevi zaziyizinhloko zemindeni yazo; bahlala eJerusalema.
EGibeyoni kwakuhlala uyise kaGibeyoni, uJehiyeli, ogama lomkakhe lalinguMahega.
Izibulo lakhe u-Abidoni, noSuri, noKishi, noBali, noNeri, noNadabi,
noGedori, no-Ajo, noZakariya, noMikiloti.
UMikilothi wazala uShimeyamu. Futhi bahlala nabafowabo eJerusalema, ngokumelene abafowabo.
Futhi uNeri wazala uKishi; uKishi wayenguyise kaSawule; uSawule wazala uJonathani, noMalikishuwa, no-Abinadaba, no-Eshbhali.
Indodana kaJonathani yayinguMeribhali, uMeribhali wayenguyise kaMika.
Amadodana kaMika: ngoPitoni, noMeleki, noThareya, no-Agasi.
U-Ahazi wazala uJara; uJara wazala u-Alemeti, no-Asmaweti, noZimri; uZimri wazala uMose;
UMose wazala uBhineya; noRefaya indodana yakhe, no-Eleyasa indodana yakhe, no-Aseli indodana yakhe.
U-Aseli wayenamadodana ayisithupha, amagama awo la: ngo-Azirikamu, noBhokeru, no-Ishmayeli, noShehariya, no-Obhadiya, noHanani; labo babe ngamadodana ka-Aseli.
